regime.summary: SBP cut 100bp on 2025-05-05 to 11.0% with CPI at 0.26%, so the easing cycle is live and real rates are high. But KSE100 is already +64.8% in 12m and +28.3% in 6m, and first-cut base rates rest on n=3. Constructive but not stretched-all-in: moderate core, no speculative entries.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 11.0%; last MPC decision 2025-05-05: cut (-100bp)
CPI YoY 0.26% for 2025-04 (published by 2025-05-03); three months earlier (2025-01) 2.42%

core.thesis: E&P led after the first cut in the prior easing cycle; trades at a very low P/E with a 7.5% dividend yield and sits within about 8% of its 252-day high, so it is not extended. Brent is weak, which is the risk.

evidence.quote: fertilizer, E&P and pharma led while banks lagged

core.thesis: Fertilizer led the first-cut cycle and has its own catalyst rather than rate sensitivity. P/E 4.5, dividend yield 8.9%, flat YoY EPS, at the 252-day high, so confirmed rather than a falling knife.

evidence.quote: Lesson: favour sectors with their own catalyst over rate-sensitive ones.

watch.subject: MLCF
watch.trigger: EPS yoy +0.708 on 2024-12-31 data, +23% 1m, 3m +66%, near high with a material-info filing on 2025-05-09. Already rerated, so no entry; revisit only after a new results print.

not_known: The next MPC date, IMF status, reserves and current account, and the full text of any material-information filing are not in the pack. Method files were not supplied, so mechanism claims cite situations.md and base_rates.csv only.
contamination_note: No post-2025-05-16 knowledge used. base_rates.csv carries a warning that it was measured partly after this date, so it is used only as rough odds for a type, not for specific names.
